summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Q1 (USD vs INR share of imports and external debt) and Q2 (long-run INR/USD and implications for NPR/USD) are pending. Leads located: NRB forex page and API, NRB historical exchange-rate workbooks, NRB WP 3 on pre-peg history, NRB FXM directives and the RBI Nepal/Bhutan exchange-control supplement (define which India trade is INR-settled), NRB CME annual FY2024/25 and August 2026 release (reserves by currency, trade by India/others), RBI reference rate archive, DBIE and Handbook tables for long-run INR/USD, PDMO monthly debt statistics and MTDS 2024 (external debt by currency), and IDS/WDI cross-check series. No primary tabulation of the invoicing currency of Nepal's imports was located; a proxy method is proposed. Identity recorded as an assumption: with an unchanged peg, NPR/USD follows INR/USD scaled by the peg ratio; reconciliation of rate types (buying/selling/middle, average/end-period) and bases (Nepal FY, Indian FY, calendar) is required (conflict C-18).

findings.claim: Q1: Share of Nepal's merchandise imports invoiced/settled in USD (convertible currency) versus INR, latest Nepal FY and trend.
findings.note: No published tabulation of invoice or settlement currency located. Proxy options: NRB BoP/CME split of imports from India (typically INR-settled) vs other countries, adjusted for convertible-currency payments to India permitted under NRB FXM directives and the RBI Nepal/Bhutan exchange-control supplement; or NRB LC/foreign-exchange payment records by currency (supervisory, may not be public).

findings.claim: Q1: Currency composition of Nepal's external public debt (SDR, USD, JPY, EUR, CNY, INR, other).
findings.note: PDMO monthly Government Debt Statistics (mid-August 2025, mid-March 2026) and MTDS 2024; IDS currency-composition series (calendar year-end). SDR-denominated debt must be looked through to the SDR basket to estimate effective USD exposure; that look-through is an estimate method, not a fact.

findings.claim: Q1: Currency composition of gross foreign-exchange reserves (convertible vs INR).
findings.note: NRB CME reserves table (FY2024/25 annual; August 2026 release).

findings.claim: Q2: Long-run INR/USD path (annual average and end-period), from the Bretton Woods era to 2026.
findings.note: RBI Handbook table, FAQ 1945-1971, Reference Rate Archive, DBIE; FBIL after July 2018 (FBIL not in catalog).

findings.claim: Q2: Long-run NPR/USD and NPR/INR paths, including dates of each peg realignment.
findings.note: NRB forex API and historical xlsx files; NRB WP 3 for pre-peg history; WDI PA.NUS.FCRF as a cross-check (calendar average; conflict register C-18).

findings.claim: Under an unchanged NPR-INR peg, NPR/USD equals the peg ratio times INR/USD; so the NPR/USD path is determined by INR/USD plus the probability-free scenario of peg realignment. The implied NPR/USD from RBI INR/USD and the NRB peg must be reconciled with NRB's published NPR/USD (differences can arise from buying/selling vs middle rates, timing of fixing and averaging).
findings.note: Identity under an assumed unchanged peg; stated as an assumption, not a forecast.

findings.claim: Long-run INR/USD movement is treated as the main driver of NPR depreciation against the USD; any scenario path is a stress setting anchored on historical dispersion computed in r2, not a forecast.

data_gaps: Invoice/settlement currency of Nepal's imports and exports: no public NRB or customs tabulation located; NRB foreign-exchange payment data by currency may be supervisory.
FBIL (Financial Benchmarks India) reference rates after July 2018 are not in the source catalog; DBIE may suffice.
IMF AREAER entry for Nepal (de jure and de facto arrangement classification) not located as a lead in r1 (search budget exhausted).
Dated record of each NPR-INR peg realignment from an NRB primary document not yet located.
The session web-search budget was exhausted before all planned searches ran; some leads below were reused from 16A/16B and some document-level leads remain unlocated (listed individually).
No lead URL was downloaded in r1 (data hosts blocked); all values await `python -m src.cli leads --fetch`, extraction and ingest in r2.

assumptions.text: Imports from India are provisionally treated as INR-settled except for categories NRB/RBI rules allow or require to be paid in convertible currency; this proxy is an estimate method to be replaced by direct currency data if obtainable.
SDR-denominated debt is decomposed using the SDR basket weights in force at each valuation date (IMF), labelled as estimate.
The peg is held unchanged in the baseline; realignment is a scenario setting (S02, S03, S10), not a forecast.

challenges.text: EXP-10 (NPR-INR peg) metrics should distinguish invoicing currency, settlement currency and currency of debt; 16B's data gap on invoicing currency is confirmed and a proxy method is proposed here.

Agent 03 exchange-rate module should take INR/USD as the exogenous driver and the peg ratio as a parameter; NPR/USD should not be projected independently while the peg holds. Rate type and FY conversion must match NRB conventions (C-18).
External-debt currency composition (PDMO, IDS) serves both 20B and 20C; use one reconciled currency table with coverage (central government vs PPG vs total) stated (C-09).

uncertainty: High. No value retrieved. Invoicing-currency shares may be unobtainable from public sources and would then remain an estimate based on a proxy. Rate series differ by type (buying/selling/middle), averaging and fiscal basis, which can create apparent discrepancies unrelated to economics.
